task.title: Finally verify inquiry/chat delivery and capacity fallback
task.input: product-contact, visitor/operator chat, existing contact channels and independent availability switch
task.output: visitor-acceptance: product-context inquiry/chat exchange and a capacity-limit report
task.accept: 1) Use the visible product contact entry to submit real POST /api/inquiries and POST /api/chat/conversations; verify productSlug/stable message IDs. ADMIN/SALES replies through the inbox and the visitor receives it through seq synchronization. Network failure preserves the current-tab draft, retrying the same UUID creates only one message, receipt remains independent from notification failure, and refusing analytics still allows consultation (E-16, E-18, E-31, E-37, E-40). 2) In the isolated target environment, measure memory/concurrency/latency with chat on and off and record limitations. If insufficient, actually disable the independent chat availability switch while retaining visible existing contact/inquiry entries; show unavailable, never fake online. Do not treat the old roughly 2.7GB snapshot as current capacity or purchase expansion automatically (E-20).
